title: Enterprise Biometric Access Control -Next Sourcing Limited
client_name: Next Sourcing Limited, Colombo, Sri Lanka
description: We successfully implemented a comprehensive biometric access control system for Next Sourcing Limited’s corporate headquarters in Colombo, securing all entry points with a unified network of fingerprint and facial recognition terminals integrated with optical turnstile gates. The solution was seamlessly connected to their existing HR attendance platform, delivering real-time access logs, automated security violation alerts, and streamlined workforce tracking. Alongside the deployment, our team provided expert, budget-aligned recommendations for the most suitable fingerprint recognition hardware, ensuring Next Sourcing Limited achieved optimal security performance and system compatibility without exceeding their financial constraints.

title: Smart HRIS Implementation - Abans Environmental Services (Pvt) Ltd
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Abans Environmental Services (Pvt) Ltd., a subsidiary of the renowned Abans Group operating in the environmental and facilities management sector, covering a workforce of approximately 12529 employees spread across field operations and administrative teams. The implementation included Attendance Management, Self Service Portal, Performance Appraisal, and Recruitment modules, tailored to address the unique challenges of managing a dispersed, field-based workforce. Before deployment, tracking attendance and managing appraisals across multiple locations was a significant operational burden. Post-implementation, field team attendance is captured in real time, performance appraisal cycles are structured and consistent across all divisions, and the recruitment process has become a streamlined, trackable pipeline. The organisation significantly reduced HR administrative overheads and created a more accountable and engaged workforce through digital HR transformation.

title: Kelani Cables
description: Successfully deployed the Smart HRIS cloud platform for Kelani Cables, one of Sri Lanka's foremost cable manufacturing companies, covering approximately 526 employees across its production facilities and corporate offices. The implementation encompassed the full suite of modules including Attendance Management, Self Service Portal, Online Salary Processing, Performance Appraisal, and Recruitment. Prior to deployment, the organisation relied heavily on manual attendance registers and spreadsheet-based payroll processes that were time-consuming and error-prone. Following the digital transformation, shift scheduling and overtime tracking became fully automated, salary processing was reduced to a fraction of its previous timeline, and employees gained direct access to their HR data through the self-service portal. Kelani Cables achieved measurable productivity improvements across both the shop floor and the HR function, eliminating manual reconciliation entirely and enabling its HR team to focus on strategic workforce planning rather than administrative tasks.

title: LRDC Services
description: The Smart HRIS cloud platform was successfully implemented for LRDC Services, a government-backed organisation operating under the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development as a subsidiary of Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, covering over 8890 employees. The deployment included Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, Performance Appraisal, and Self Service Portal modules, designed to meet the stringent compliance and reporting requirements of a public sector institution. Prior to the implementation, the organisation faced challenges in maintaining consistent HR records, generating statutory reports, and running payroll with full accuracy. Following the go-live, LRDC Services achieved full compliance in HR documentation, established a transparent appraisal process aligned with public sector standards, and eliminated manual salary reconciliation. The platform brought accountability and structure to the organisation's HR operations while ensuring regulatory requirements were consistently met.

title: ACL Cables
description: Smart HRIS was deployed enterprise-wide for ACL Cables, one of Sri Lanka's largest cable and wire manufacturers with a workforce of over 814 employees spanning production, engineering, sales, and corporate functions. The implementation covered all five core modules — Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, Self Service Portal, Performance Appraisal, and Recruitment — and was rolled out across multiple business units simultaneously. The organisation had long struggled with siloed HR practices across departments, inconsistent appraisal frameworks, and a high administrative burden on its payroll team. Post-deployment, ACL Cables achieved group-wide HR standardisation, with unified attendance policies, automated salary processing for the entire workforce, and a structured appraisal cycle that now drives performance conversations at every level of the organisation. The digital transformation enabled ACL Cables to scale its HR operations to match the ambitions of a market-leading manufacturer.

title: Sinha
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Sinha, covering a workforce of approximately 210 employees. The implementation included Attendance Management, Self Service Portal, and Online Salary Processing modules, providing the organisation with the digital HR foundation it needed to move beyond manual, spreadsheet-driven processes. Before deployment, attendance tracking was inconsistent and payroll preparation required significant manual effort each month. Following the implementation, attendance data flows automatically into the payroll engine, employees access their payslips and leave balances independently through the self-service portal, and the HR team has reclaimed a significant portion of its working hours. The project delivered a clean, efficient HR operation with measurable reductions in administrative time and a noticeable improvement in employee experience.

title: Smart HRIS Implementation - SkyNet Worldwide Express
description: The Smart HRIS cloud platform was successfully deployed for SkyNet Worldwide Express, a leading international courier and logistics company operating across Sri Lanka with a workforce of approximately 100employees across depots, sorting hubs, and administrative offices. The implementation covered Attendance Management, Recruitment, Online Salary Processing, and Self Service Portal modules, addressing the specific demands of a fast-paced logistics operation with complex shift patterns and seasonal staffing requirements. Prior to the deployment, managing attendance across multiple locations and running payroll for a variable workforce was a persistent operational challenge. Post-implementation, real-time attendance visibility was established across all depots, the recruitment pipeline became structured and measurable — significantly reducing time-to-hire during peak seasons — and monthly payroll processing was automated end-to-end. SkyNet Worldwide Express now operates with greater agility and has eliminated the manual HR bottlenecks that previously slowed its operations.

title: Lanka Mineral Sands Ltd
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Lanka Mineral Sands Ltd, a state enterprise engaged in mineral extraction and processing, covering a multi-site workforce of approximately 536 employees. The implementation included Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, Performance Appraisal, and Self Service Portal modules, tailored to the operational and compliance requirements of a government-affiliated industrial organisation. The company previously managed HR across its sites using disparate systems and manual records, creating inconsistencies in attendance data and payroll accuracy. Following the deployment, all sites were unified under a single cloud-based HR platform, payroll processing is handled with full statutory accuracy, and performance appraisal data now feeds directly into the organisation's annual workforce planning process. Lanka Mineral Sands Ltd achieved a significant leap in HR operational efficiency and now maintains a centralised, auditable record of all HR activities across its operations.

title: Ruhunu
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Ruhunu, a food manufacturing company with a workforce of approximately 301 employees engaged in production, quality assurance, logistics, and administration. The implementation covered Attendance Management, Performance Appraisal, Recruitment, and Online Salary Processing modules, designed to address the demands of a manufacturing environment where workforce discipline and structured performance management are essential to product quality and operational efficiency. Previously, the organisation managed attendance manually through registers and conducted appraisals without a standardised framework. Following the deployment, attendance is captured accurately at every shift, a consistent appraisal cycle has been introduced across all departments, and the recruitment process has been standardised to attract and retain quality talent. The company reported a reduction in workforce turnover following the introduction of structured appraisals, and payroll is now processed accurately and on schedule every month.

title: Magi Lanka (Manufactures of Kookai)
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Magi Lanka, the Sri Lankan manufacturer of the internationally recognised Kookai fashion brand, covering approximately 1174 employees across design, production, retail, and administrative functions. The implementation included Recruitment, Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, and Self Service Portal modules, tailored to the fast-moving demands of the fashion retail industry. The business faced challenges in managing seasonal workforce fluctuations, running payroll across a multi-function team, and maintaining consistent attendance policies across locations. Following deployment, seasonal recruitment campaigns are managed through a structured pipeline that has halved the time-to-hire, attendance policies are uniformly enforced, and monthly payroll runs are completed accurately and on schedule. Magi Lanka now operates with an HR function as dynamic and organised as the brand it represents.

title: Trendy
description: The Smart HRIS platform was successfully deployed for Trendy, a multi-location fashion retail brand with a workforce of approximately 134 employees across store operations, head office, and support functions. The implementation covered Attendance Management, Performance Appraisal, Online Salary Processing, and Self Service Portal modules, addressing the complex HR needs of a retail business managing staff across multiple outlets. Prior to deployment, attendance management was inconsistent across locations, appraisals were conducted informally without structured frameworks, and payroll was processed manually — leading to occasional delays and errors. Following the go-live, a uniform attendance policy was enforced across all locations, a fair and transparent appraisal process was introduced for all staff grades, and the organisation achieved a 100% on-time payroll rate from the first month of operation. Store managers report a significant improvement in HR clarity, and the self-service portal has reduced inbound HR queries by over half.

title: Cable Solutions
description: The Smart HRIS cloud platform was successfully implemented for Cable Solutions, a cable manufacturing and distribution company with a workforce of approximately 390 employees. The deployment covered Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, and Recruitment modules, providing the organisation with a focused, efficient HR system that delivered results from day one. The company had been managing HR through manual processes that were time-intensive and prone to errors, particularly in payroll calculation and new hire onboarding. Post-implementation, payroll accuracy reached 100% from the very first processing cycle, attendance is tracked with precision across all shifts, and the recruitment module has reduced time-to-hire significantly. Cable Solutions achieved a full return on its HR technology investment within the first quarter of operation, with the HR team describing the transformation as the most impactful operational change in recent years.

title: Rotax Limited
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Rotax Limited, a well-established Sri Lankan company covering a workforce of approximately 200 employees across its operational and administrative divisions. The full suite of modules — Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, Self Service Portal, and Performance Appraisal — was implemented as part of a comprehensive digital HR transformation. For years, the organisation had relied on manual HR processes that created bottlenecks, frustrated employees, and limited the HR team's ability to focus on people development. Following the go-live, payroll is processed automatically with full accuracy, performance appraisals are structured and data-driven, employees access their HR information independently through the portal, and the HR team's capacity has been freed by over 50%. Rotax Limited now operates a modern, future-ready HR function that has transformed the organisation's relationship with its own people.

title: Commercial Insurance Brokers
description: Smart HRIS was successfully implemented for Commercial Insurance Brokers, a professional financial services organisation with approximately 100 employees. The deployment included Online Salary Processing, Performance Appraisal, Recruitment, and Self Service Portal modules, reflecting the organisation's commitment to the same standards of precision and compliance that it delivers to its clients. Previously, payroll processing required significant manual verification to maintain accuracy, appraisals lacked a structured and documented framework, and the recruitment process was managed informally. Following the deployment, payroll accuracy and compliance documentation are maintained to the highest standard, performance appraisals are structured, consistent, and fully documented, and the recruitment pipeline is now a measurable, professional process. Commercial Insurance Brokers achieved full HR regulatory compliance from the point of go-live and now operates an HR function that reflects the professionalism at the core of its business identity.

title: Agro Momentum
description: The Smart HRIS platform was successfully deployed for Agro Momentum, an agricultural sector company with a workforce of approximately 300 employees engaged in field operations, processing, and administration. The implementation covered Attendance Management, Online Salary Processing, and Recruitment modules, addressing the distinctive HR challenges of an agri-business managing a largely field-based workforce subject to seasonal fluctuations. Prior to deployment, field worker attendance was tracked manually and was frequently inaccurate, payroll calculation was time-consuming, and recruitment for seasonal roles was unstructured. Post-implementation, field worker attendance accuracy improved by 88%, payroll is processed on schedule with full accuracy, and the recruitment module ensures that seasonal workforce requirements are met through a consistent and professional hiring process. Agro Momentum achieved a significant improvement in HR discipline and operational continuity across its field and processing operations.

title: Monaro
description: Smart HRIS was successfully deployed for Monaro, a focused and professionally operated Sri Lankan company with a workforce of approximately 1348 employees. The implementation included Self Service Portal, Online Salary Processing, and Performance Appraisal modules — a precisely scoped deployment that addressed the organisation's core HR needs without over-engineering the solution. Prior to the implementation, the HR function operated with minimal automation, relying on manual processes for payroll and informal approaches to performance review. Following the go-live, the entire organisation transitioned to digital HR with zero disruption to operations, payroll is processed accurately every month with no manual intervention, performance appraisals are now structured and documented, and employees engage confidently with their own HR data through the self-service portal. Monaro achieved full HR digitisation in a single, clean implementation — a testament to what the right system, implemented well, can deliver for a lean and focused organisation.
